note: hero-idle-sheet.png contains 8 frames, each 627x836 (an exact half-scale, same-composition version of hero-static.png's 1254x1672 canvas -- verified against hero-static's own alpha bounding box, so no per-frame repositioning is needed). Frame 0 is the neutral/open pose (matches hero-static.png) and frame 1 is a genuine closed-eyes blink frame, authored directly into the sheet by the artist rather than composited/cropped afterward. Frames 2-7 are the original breathing/shifting idle loop. The CSS sprite animation in main.css steps through all 8 with steps(frameCount - 1, end), i.e. steps(7, end) -- not steps(frameCount, end) -- so each step lands exactly on a frame boundary instead of a fractional offset. There is no separate blink sheet/image: js/hero.js's quick blink (see BLINK_* in that file) reuses this same sheet, jumping directly between frames 0 and 1 rather than playing the full 8-frame walk, and is mutually exclusive with the full idle animation since both drive the same layer's transform. The 'wander' behaviour in hero.js (walking toward/away from the venue) is a separate, additional idle behaviour layered on top of this frame animation.
